from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowInvesting(BaseModel):
    """Cash Flow from Investing Activities extracted from a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company the filing belongs to, as named in the document")
    cash_flow_investing: float | None = Field(description="Net cash used in/generated from investing activities; negative indicates used")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this cash flow figure")
    line_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label as written in the financial statement")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_investing: list[CashFlowInvesting]
